messages.subject: overnight alarm - close it out before the assessor gets here
messages.snippet: One of last night's alarms is still open and I want the cause on it before eleven.
messages.body:
One of last night's alarms is still open and I want the cause on it before eleven. The papers off the night file are on the shared drive.

Do not take the contractor's word for what it was, and do not take the badge reader's word for who was on site. Both are answered in the papers.

J. Pettifer

messages.subject: Larkmoor - confirmed intrusion 04/01 23:41
messages.snippet: Cold store door opened at 23:41 following a card entry at 23:39. Treating as an intrusion.
messages.body:
Cold store door opened at 23:41 following a card entry at 23:39. On our side that is an intrusion and we have logged it as one. Please resolve the alarm on your system with intrusion as the cause so the two records agree, and we will raise the callout invoice against it.

Verrimoor Night Desk

messages.subject: Re: Larkmoor - confirmed intrusion 04/01 23:41
messages.snippet: Holding that until we have been through the night file ourselves.
messages.body:
Holding that until we have been through the night file ourselves. A door contact reporting open is not the same thing as somebody going through it, and what we put on our own record is settled here rather than at your desk.

Control

messages.subject: Re: Larkmoor - confirmed intrusion 04/01 23:41
messages.snippet: We are not withdrawing it. Card at 23:39, door at 23:41. That is an intrusion.
messages.body:
We are not withdrawing it. Card at 23:39, door at 23:41, two minutes apart on the same site. That is an intrusion by any reading and our operators are trained to call it one. Put intrusion on the alarm.

Verrimoor Night Desk

messages.subject: manifest - sorry, came back for it late
messages.snippet: Swung back just before midnight for the Kelsall manifest. In and out of the gate office.
messages.body:
Swung back just before midnight for the Kelsall manifest I had left behind. In and out of the gate office, five minutes at the outside, never went past the yard and nowhere near the chill side. My own card has been failing on the gate reader for a fortnight so I got in on one off the hook in the office.

E. Sarafian

messages.subject: Thursday drop - pallet count
messages.snippet: Fourteen pallets on Thursday rather than twelve, chilled as usual.
messages.body:
Fourteen pallets on Thursday rather than twelve, chilled as usual. Let us know if that is a problem for the cold store.

Kelsall Despatch

messages.subject: Site visit Monday 5 January, 11:00
messages.snippet: Our assessor will attend at 11:00 on Monday to review the alarm record.
messages.body:
Our assessor will attend at 11:00 on Monday to review the alarm record for the December and January period. Please have every alarm on the system closed with a stated cause.

Ashmore Underwriting
